content.thinking:
I need to plan out the elephant model carefully without being able to test it live, so I'm sketching the overall proportions—roughly 3.2m shoulder height, 6m body length, facing forward and centered—then thinking through low-poly construction using capsule and sweep shapes for the body and limbs.

The barrel-shaped torso uses an elliptical cross-section via a sweep with varying radii, with legs as tapered rod shapes ending in flat-capped feet near ground level, plus small toenail boxes added at the front. Now I'm working out the head as a rounded sphere-based shape with low segment counts to keep the geometry simple.

Still shaping trunk geometry... now thinking through the ears — extruding a flat outline sideways with some thickness, oriented along the back of the head with a slight upward tilt.

Still working out ear geometry...

Now moving to the tusks, sweeping a curved path with a tapered ivory radius from near the face curving down and forward to a point, then placing small dark sphere eyes on the head.

I'm sketching the head geometry: a skull sphere with a forehead bump and lowered jaw sphere, plus the trunk root position, then checking that the eye placement actually sits correctly on the head sphere's surface and nudging it if needed.

Now I'm working out the tail sweep from upper back down to a tapered tip with a tuft, then defining the body's barrel-shaped path with varying radii that taper at both ends for a rounded silhouette.

For coloring, I'm setting up a grey-brown skin tone with darker mottling and lighter dusty patches on the lower legs, using a paint function that blends the two based on vertical position.

Adding ankle wrinkle rings with small torus shapes...

For body texture I'll layer stripe-based folds and mottled spots for skin variation. I'm adding ivory-grey toenail boxes along the front of each foot, and considering small details like a mouth line while skipping tusks, tail hair, and eyelashes for now.

Still writing geometry...

Now I'm sketching the module structure—exporting a build function that creates a builder for the elephant model, with imports for path curves and paint helpers, plus setting up the ear extrusion parameters.
